Reads only. Publish one version.

# ── bookkeeping kit: shared helpers (inlined into each node by gen-ext.js) ── import json import re import datetime from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo # Knowledge layout. Folders may nest at most 2 levels, so inbox folders are top-level. BK_SETTINGS = "Bookkeeping/settings.json" BK_CLIENTS = "Bookkeeping/Clients" BK_RULES = "Bookkeeping/Rules" BK_BILLS = "Bookkeeping/Bills" BK_INBOX = "Bookkeeping Inbox" BK_PROCESSED = "Bookkeeping Processed" BK_FAILED = "Bookkeeping Failed" BK_MAIL = "Bookkeeping/Mail" BK_REQUESTS = "Bookkeeping Requests" def bk_write_json(path, data): api.files.put(file=path, content=json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True)) def bk_fmt(amount, currency=""): if amount is None: return "—" return (currency + " " if currency else "") + "{:,.2f}".format(amount) def bk_tz(settings): # The sandbox may lack the tz database; fall back to AEST (UTC+10) rather than failing the run. try: return ZoneInfo((settings or {}).get("timezone") or "Australia/Sydney") except Exception: return datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=10)) def bk_now_iso(settings): return datetime.datetime.now(bk_tz(settings)).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() # ── bookkeeping kit: payroll adapter (inlined into payroll nodes by gen-ext.js) ── # Xero Payroll AU through xero-payroll-au (reads take xero_tenant_id, so each call lands in the client's own # organisation) and Deputy through deputy. Read-only: the checks list corrections, the payroll officer makes them. import csv import io from openpyxl import Workbook, load_workbook BK_PAYROLL = "Bookkeeping/Payroll" BK_PAYRUNS = "Bookkeeping/PayRuns" BK_PAYROLL_FILES = "Bookkeeping Payroll" PAYROLL = "xero-payroll-au" DEPUTY = "deputy" PAY_WEEKDAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"] PAY_BANDS = ["ordinary", "early", "late", "saturday", "sunday", "public_holiday", "ot_first", "ot_after"] PAY_BAND_NAMES = {"ordinary": "ordinary", "early": "early (before start of day)", "late": "late (after end of day)", "saturday": "Saturday", "sunday": "Sunday", "public_holiday": "public holiday", "ot_first": "overtime (first hours)", "ot_after": "overtime (after that)"} # ── Report and draft queries ── import html as _html QUERY_PROMPT = ( "Draft one email from a payroll officer at a bookkeeping practice to the client's staff member who looks after " "timesheets, asking them to confirm the points below before payroll is finalised. Group the points by employee, keep " "each one short and specific (dates and hours), be polite and plain. Plain text, no subject line, sign off as the " "payroll team. Use only the facts given." ) problem = params.get("problem") or "" ctx = params.get("ctx") or {} f = params.get("findings") or {} settings = ctx.get("settings") or {} ps = ctx.get("payroll") or {} run = dict(ctx.get("run") or {}) run_path = ctx.get("run_path") or "" open_items = 0 report_url = "" def _esc(v): return _html.escape(str(v if v is not None else "—")) def _table(title, head, rows): if not rows: return "" out = ["

" + "".join("" for h in head) + ""] for r in rows: out.append("" + "".join("" for c in r) + "") return "".join(out) + "
" + _esc(h) + "
" + _esc(c) + "
" if problem: if run.get("item_id"): api.workq.comment(todo_id=run["item_id"], body=problem) elif run.get("item_id"): sections = [ ("Missing in Xero Payroll (hours in Deputy)", ["Employee"], [[n] for n in f.get("missing_starters") or []], "add them before the pay run"), ("Salaried staff with timesheets", ["Employee", "Hours"], [[r["name"], r["hours"]] for r in f.get("salaried_timesheets") or []], "delete these timesheets: salaried staff are paid their standard hours"), ("Hours that differ (Deputy vs Xero)", ["Employee", "Date", "Deputy", "Xero"], [[r["name"], r["date"], r["deputy"], r["xero"]] for r in f.get("hours") or []], "fix in Xero or ask the client"), ("Penalty bands that differ (from shift times vs Xero)", ["Employee", "Band", "Expected hours", "Xero hours"], [[r["name"], PAY_BAND_NAMES.get(r["band"], r["band"]), r["expected"], r["xero"]] for r in f.get("bands") or []], "check the earnings lines"), ("Rates that differ from the pay guide", ["Employee", "Band", "Pay guide", "Xero", "Note"], [[r["name"], PAY_BAND_NAMES.get(r["band"], r["band"]), r["expected"], r["xero"], r.get("note") or ""] for r in f.get("rates") or []], "update the pay item or the pay guide"), ("Not in the pay guide's employees sheet", ["Employee"], [[n] for n in f.get("unclassified") or []], "add their award and classification so their rates can be checked"), ("Reimbursements that differ", ["Employee", "Reimbursement file", "Draft pay run"], [[r["name"], r["file"], r["pay_run"]] for r in f.get("reimbursements") or []], "fix the reimbursement lines"), ("Changes this period", ["Employee", "Change"], [[r["name"], r["text"]] for r in f.get("changes") or []], "act on these"), ] open_items = sum(len(rows) for _, _, rows, _ in sections if rows) - len(f.get("changes") or []) t = f.get("totals") or {} page = ["Payroll check", "

Payroll check: " + _esc(run.get("name")) + ", " + _esc(f.get("period")) + "

"] if t: page.append(_table("Draft pay run", ["Wages", "Tax", "Super", "Deductions", "Reimbursements", "Net pay"], [[bk_fmt(t.get("Wages")), bk_fmt(t.get("Tax")), bk_fmt(t.get("Super")), bk_fmt(t.get("Deductions")), bk_fmt(t.get("Reimbursement")), bk_fmt(t.get("NetPay"))]])) for title, head, rows, _ in sections: page.append(_table(title, head, rows)) if not open_items: page.append("

" + what[0].upper() + what[1:] + ".") for n in f.get("notes") or []: lines.append("- " + n) if report_url: lines.append("\n[Open the full check](" + report_url + ")") asks = ([{"employee": n, "point": "has hours in Deputy but isn't set up in Xero Payroll"} for n in f.get("missing_starters") or []] + [{"employee": r["name"], "point": r["date"] + ": Deputy shows " + str(r["deputy"]) + " hours, Xero " + str(r["xero"])} for r in f.get("hours") or []]) if asks and ps.get("ts_owner"): email = api.ai.generate(prompt=QUERY_PROMPT, input=json.dumps({ "to": ps.get("ts_owner"), "business": run.get("name"), "pay_period": f.get("period"), "points": asks[:60]})) lines.append("\n**Draft query email to " + ps["ts_owner"] + (" (" + ps["ts_email"] + ")" if ps.get("ts_email") else "") + "** for you to edit and send:\n\n" + str(email)) api.workq.comment(todo_id=run["item_id"], body="\n".join(lines)) api.workq.set_status(todo_id=run["item_id"], status="in_progress") run["status"] = "checked" run["last_check"] = {"at": bk_now_iso(settings), "open_items": open_items, "url": report_url, "summary": [t + ": " + str(len(r)) for t, _, r, _ in sections if r], "changes": [c["name"] + ": " + c["text"] for c in f.get("changes") or []], "totals": f.get("totals") or {}} run.setdefault("checks", []).append({"at": run["last_check"]["at"], "open_items": open_items, "url": report_url}) bk_write_json(run_path, run)
